method: One Claude Code Opus 5.5 caller per arm, six supplied scenarios per executor. Launch and corrective effects were simulated. The candidate caller also inspected the simulation wrapper. Ten real CLI commands per arm, plus four simulated corrective checks. A deterministic replay at the published head matched all ten candidate command receipts including exit status, stdout and stderr.
